name: 奔波鼠
evolution: 奔波鼠 → 流浪鼠 Lv.32
description: 毛色杂乱且粗糙，像是融合了泥土、枯叶的颜色，黑色的眼睛透露出机灵的光。它们背着自己的全部家当，在野外长期流浪，一直在路上，从未到达旅途的终点。有着健壮的身躯，但进攻意愿低，只对闪闪发光的东西兴趣浓厚。
descriptionEn: Its fur is messy and coarse, as if blended with the colors of dirt and dead leaves, and its black eyes show a clever gleam. Carrying all its belongings, it wanders in the wild for long periods, always on the road, never reaching the journey's end. It has a sturdy body but low willingness to attack, interested only in shiny things.
